name: popcorn-room
description: Popcorn Room (SyncRoom) - a free watch party with studio-clean shared audio, synced YouTube, chat and a people panel.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @popcorn/api" "npm run dev -w @popcorn/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @popcorn/web && npm run typecheck -w @popcorn/api
